feature: Expand shortlist to 20 + adaptive weights when extracted_files is empty
problem: HBASE-4577 GT at rank 17 (barely outside top 15). When JIRA has no file hints, file_overlap=0 for ALL candidates and the 50% weight is wasted — scoring degenerates to rank preservation only. GROOVY-5775 (rank 31) and IGNITE-1787 (rank 29) are deeper and may need future formula work, but the simple expansion + adaptive weights covers the clearest win.
proposed_solution: Two changes in scoring.py: (1) DEFAULT_SHORTLIST_SIZE from 15 to 20. (2) When problem.extracted_files is empty, use adaptive weights {file_overlap: 0.0, signal_count: 0.6, rank: 0.4} since file_overlap is meaningless without file hints. Both are zero-LLM-cost changes.
acceptance_criteria: AC2: When extracted_files is empty, file_overlap weight is 0.0 and signal_count is 0.6, rank is 0.4
AC3: When extracted_files is non-empty, default weights are unchanged (0.5/0.3/0.2)
AC4: Custom weights parameter still overrides adaptive logic
AC5: All existing tests pass (some may need shortlist_size adjustment)
AC6: Only scoring.py and test_narrowing.py changed
edge_cases: EC1: Empty candidate set + empty extracted_files returns empty shortlist (no crash)
EC2: Single candidate + empty extracted_files produces valid score
EC3: extracted_files=[''] (whitespace-only) still counts as non-empty (existing behavior preserved)
verification_method: Evaluator should: (1) Read scoring.py and verify adaptive weight logic. (2) Verify DEFAULT_SHORTLIST_SIZE == 20. (3) Run full test suite. (4) Verify only scoring.py and test_narrowing.py changed.
